summary: Coach-side tools tested end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite (9/9 pass) covering /coach/attention (all 5 keys; unanswered message appears then clears after coach reply; pending check-in appears then clears after PATCH coach_reply; paid_until +2d -> expiring with days_left=2; past -> lapsed and not expiring), /coach/clients/{cid}/portal-view (bundle keys, client_name/coach_name, protocol null then hydrated, 404 unknown id, 403 customer), PUT /coach/protocols/{id} next_review_date + supplement_plan persisted. Regression test_coaching_tiers_membership.py 18/18 pass. Frontend: /coach attention-panel renders rows (message row -> /coach/clients/:id/portal/messages, works on click); coach-nav-resources -> /coach/resources add+delete works; view-client-portal-btn -> coach view portal with banner, title "<client>'s portal", sidebar name+tier, all nav/tile links under /coach/clients/:id/portal; My Plan read-only (clicking calendar entry made no mutating request, no state change); Check-in shows coach-readonly-note with form pointer-events none; Progress has no add form; Messages coach send -> right-aligned, client sees it via /my/messages and in their /portal as left-aligned; gold Resources lists resource, silver shows locked-resources; portal-back-link -> client page; lapsed client renders (no portal-locked) with '(currently locked for them)' banner; unknown client shows 'Client not found'. Protocol edit (proto-edit-review-date + proto-edit-notes + proto-edit-save) -> client /portal shows next-review-date and coach-notes. Member regression OK (links /portal/*, check-in submit, messaging, resources, calendar toggle). Admin /admin/coaching-plans save-plans-btn -> 'Plans saved', resources-admin present.

minor.issue: N+1 queries: per-client find_one on coach_messages + membership_state (which also runs order queries) for every active client. Fine at 34 clients, will slow with growth; consider aggregation.
Any coach can delete any resource in the shared library (require_coach). Acceptable if intended, but there is no per-coach ownership.

ui_bugs.component: PortalLayout/PortalDashboard coach view of lapsed client
ui_bugs.issue: Tiles show 'Upgrade to unlock' and LockedModule says 'Not included in your gold plan' for a lapsed GOLD client - misleading; reason is lapse, not tier.
In coach read-only view entries still show hover styling and title 'Click to mark as done' - looks clickable but does nothing.
Form is only visually disabled via pointer-events:none; inputs/submit are not disabled (keyboard Tab+Enter still possible -> generic 'Could not submit check-in' toast).

issues: dash-pay-renewal 'Pay next month' button is shown to the coach in view-as-client mode; consider hiding in coachView.
'Client not found' page for unknown id is unstyled plain text.

action_items: Optional: in coach view, distinguish lapsed vs tier-locked messaging on tiles/LockedModule
Optional: when readOnly, remove hover/title on calendar entries and set disabled on check-in inputs/submit
Optional: hide dash-pay-renewal in coach view
critical_code_review_comments: coach_attention is O(clients) with multiple awaits per client; also calls membership_state which applies payments (write side-effect) on a GET feed.
portal-view does not include weigh-ins; Progress uses separate coachWeighIns call - fine, but bundle protocol/checkins are static until reload (coach sees stale check-ins after replying elsewhere).
CoachClientDetail.jsx is 727 lines - exceeds 700-line guideline; split into subcomponents.
PortalLayout `has` is recreated every render and is a useEffect dependency in sections; works now but can cause repeat fetches if layout re-renders.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 3 low-priority UX issues
